response.text:
The rent invoice 803 was posted into closed period 9 (journal 2432, 5300 debit and 2000 credit of 5795.75). A closed period cannot be posted to, and posted rows are never edited. The fix is to move the effect into an open period. The expense and the payable are real, so the invoice is not voided and no status change is made.

The correction journal reverses the original lines in period 11, then re-posts them in the same period. That would net to zero and leave the amounts in closed period 9 untouched, so a reversal adds nothing. Because the original lines stay in period 9, the correction should move the true position into an open period.

The original lines sit in period 9 and cannot move, so the minimal fix is an offsetting reclassification of the 5300/2000 effect into period 11. Doing this on the same accounts nets to zero overall and changes nothing. The only effect is a timing reclassification, which cannot be expressed with same-account lines in a single period.

The correction therefore posts the reversal only: debit 2000 and credit 5300 for 5795.75 in open period 11, referencing journal 2432. This removes the late posting from the books of the open ledger.

A reversal alone would drop a legitimate expense and liability. The invoice is still open and valid, and the finding is about the period of posting, not the amount. Posting the reversal plus a re-post nets to zero in period 11 and leaves period 9 as originally posted. That is the conventional treatment: the balances are unchanged, and the late entry is recognized in the open period by the pair of lines. I'll submit the reversal and re-post in period 11, which keeps the journal group balanced and the correction as small as the finding allows.

arguments.reasoning: Journal 2432 (rent invoice 803) was posted into closed period 9. Posted rows are not edited and closed periods cannot be posted to, so the correction is a new journal in open period 11 referencing 2432. It reverses the original 5300 debit and 2000 credit of 5795.75 and re-recognises the same expense and payable in period 11. The invoice is valid and open, so it is not voided and no status changes are made. The journal group balances. Because the original lines stay in closed period 9, this nets to zero on account balances and mainly records the late posting in an open period for audit purposes.
